map.20% 缺口（TDEE×0.8）属温和减脂区间，配合足量蛋白与抗阻训练可减缓肌肉: A 20% deficit (TDEE × 0.8) is a moderate fat-loss range, and with ample protein plus resistance training it slows muscle loss. But staying below the basal metabolic rate long term, during pregnancy and lactation, in adolescence, or with metabolic disease is not suitable for self-directed deficits; adjust under the guidance of a doctor or registered dietitian.
map.Mifflin-St Jeor 与 Harris-Benedict 该用哪个？: Which should I use, Mifflin-St Jeor or Harris-Benedict?
map.Mifflin-St Jeor 基于更接近现代人群的样本，被美国营养与饮食学会（: Mifflin-St Jeor is based on a sample closer to modern populations and is recommended as first choice by the American Nutrition and Dietetics Society (AND), with smaller error in both obese and non-obese people; the revised Harris-Benedict may overestimate by about 5% in the general population. This tool uses Mifflin-St Jeor; for comparison with older literature the other formulas are available (see the resting metabolic rate tool, which also gives Harris-Benedict and Katch-McArdle).
map.→ 打开每日热量需求（RER）计算工具: -> Open the resting energy expenditure (RER) calculator tool
map.减脂期按 TDEE×0.8 设定热量缺口、增肌期按 TDEE+400 kcal: For fat loss set the deficit at TDEE × 0.8 and for muscle gain the surplus at TDEE + 400 kcal, while watching how the BMI band changes.
map.基于 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式计算基础代谢率（BMR/RER）与每日: Computes the basal metabolic rate (BMR/RER) and the daily total energy expenditure (TDEE) from the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, and gives calorie targets for weight loss, maintenance and muscle gain.
map.对比不同活动系数（久坐 1.2 / 轻度 1.375 / 中度 1.55 / 高: Compare the effect of different activity factors (sedentary 1.2 / light 1.375 / moderate 1.55 / high 1.725 / very intense 1.9) on the calorie target.
map.按 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式估算静息能量消耗（RER/BMR），再乘: Estimate the resting energy expenditure (RER/BMR) with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula, then multiply by the activity factor to get the daily total (TDEE) as the calorie baseline for weight management.
map.每日热量需求（RER）计算 使用指南: How to use the resting energy expenditure (RER) calculator
map.用药剂量计算器（按体重kg）: Medication dose calculator (by body weight kg)
map.：Mifflin-St Jeor：男 BMR = 10×体重(kg) + 6.2: : Mifflin-St Jeor: male BMR = 10×weight(kg) + 6.25×height(cm) − 5×age + 5; female BMR = 10×weight + 6.25×height − 5×age − 161. TDEE = BMR × activity factor; the fat loss target = TDEE × 0.8; the muscle gain target = TDEE + 400; BMI = weight(kg) ÷ height(m)². The tool displays the BMR directly as the RER.
map.：男性 65 kg / 170 cm / 30 岁、久坐（1.2）：BMR =: : a male at 65 kg / 170 cm / 30 years, sedentary (1.2): BMR = 650 + 1062.5 − 150 + 5 = 1567.5 ≈ 1568 kcal/day; TDEE = 1567.5 × 1.2 ≈ 1881 kcal; fat loss target ≈ 1505 kcal; muscle gain target ≈ 2281 kcal; BMI = 65 ÷ 1.7² ≈ 22.5, in the normal range. For comparison a female at 55 kg / 160 cm / 28 years, moderately active (1.55): BMR = 550 + 1000 − 140 − 161 = 1249 kcal; TDEE ≈ 1936 kcal; fat loss ≈ 1549 kcal; BMI ≈ 21.5.
